gloss: on the sea; offshore; on the ocean

definitions.gloss: on the sea; offshore; on the open ocean
definitions.explanation: The area on or above the open sea. Frequently used in contexts such as offshore wind power, naval operations, and marine incidents.

examples.japanese: {洋上|ようじょう}で{風|かぜ}が{強|つよ}まる。
examples.english: The wind grows stronger out at sea.

examples.japanese: {洋上|ようじょう}に{風車|ふうしゃ}を{並|なら}べる。
examples.english: Line up wind turbines out on the sea.

examples.japanese: {洋上|ようじょう}{風力|ふうりょく}{発電|はつでん}は{陸上|りくじょう}より{安定|あんてい}した{風|かぜ}が{得|え}られると{期待|きたい}されている。
examples.english: Offshore wind power is expected to obtain steadier wind than onshore.

notes:
A somewhat formal noun for the open sea, most often heard now in {洋上|ようじょう}{風力|ふうりょく}{発電|はつでん} (offshore wind power).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋上|ようじょう}{風力|ふうりょく}{発電|はつでん}: offshore wind power generation
- {洋上|ようじょう}に{出|で}る: to go out onto the open sea

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {海上|かいじょう}: on the sea — more everyday and general; {洋上|ようじょう} emphasizes the open ocean, far from land
